reviewReceipt.body:
Please update PR #175's manual verification and evidence to use real TMDb-imported movies instead of the synthetic M2 catalogue.

Required changes:

1. Configure the backend to use a database with an active TMDb-imported catalogue. Verify that the active catalogue revision has provider `tmdb`. Do not run the M2 bootstrap against this database.

2. Keep the current implementation: read `popularityScore` from our backend API. Do not add frontend TMDb requests, expose tokens, change ranking, or add frontend sorting.

3. Capture `/popular` on desktop and mobile:
   - Show real TMDb movie titles and visible popularity values.
   - Include the corresponding `GET /api/movies/popular?limit=10` response.
   - Verify displayed order matches the API order, including higher/lower scores and ties.

4. Open one of those movies:
   - Capture its details page and `GET /api/movies/<movieId>` response.
   - Verify the movie ID and displayed popularity agree with the card.
   - Use the same catalogue revision for the API/UI comparison.
   - Confirm public details still work for guests without private rating requests.

5. Update the PR description with:
   - The tested commit SHA.
   - Catalogue provider, revision and imported movie count.
   - Actual test/lint/build results.
   - Clearly labelled screenshots and matching API evidence.

Keep automated tests synthetic and independent of live TMDb. The live-data verification is a separate manual smoke test.

If the existing database already contains imported TMDb movies, reuse it without reseeding or re-importing. Use a disposable database if a fresh import is necessary.

storyAudit.title: [Story] S01 - Select favorite genres to start choosing a movie
storyAudit.statusBasis: Functional evidence exists; final T25 sign-off/review/human details remain pending; not all final DoD gates are asserted

rows.text: Given I am signed in on the home page, when I select Start, then the system opens `/preferences` and displays the available genres.
Given I select 1 to 5 valid genres while signed in, when I confirm my selection, then the system saves the choices for my account and navigates to `/recommendations`.
Given I have not selected any genre, when I confirm, then the system asks me to select at least one genre and keeps me on the same screen.
Given I have selected 5 genres, when I try to select a sixth genre, then the system shows the limit and keeps the previous 5 selections.
Given my signed-in account already has preferences, when I return to edit them, then the system shows my current selections and another account cannot see them.

storyAudit.title: [Story] S02 - Get a movie list based on preferences
storyAudit.statusBasis: Functional evidence exists; final T25 sign-off/review/human details remain pending; not all final DoD gates are asserted

rows.text: Given the signed-in account has selected valid favourite genres and matching movies exist, When recommendations are requested, Then the system displays up to 10 distinct movies that each match at least one selected genre.
Given recommendation results are displayed, When the user views a movie card, Then the card shows the movie title, genres, and a clear reason that names at least one matching selected genre.

Given no movies match the selected genres, When recommendations are requested, Then the system shows a no-match message, up to 10 popular alternative movies, and actions to change preferences or retry.
Given the recommendation source fails, When recommendations are requested, Then the system shows an error message and a retry action while keeping the selected preferences unchanged.
Given the user retries after a recommendation-source failure, When the request succeeds, Then the system displays the recommendation results.

storyAudit.title: [Story] S03 - View movie details before deciding
storyAudit.statusBasis: Functional evidence exists; final T25 sign-off/review/human details remain pending; not all final DoD gates are asserted

rows.text: Given a movie card has a valid ID, when I select View details, then the system opens the correct route and displays the movie title, year, genres, and summary.
Given the movie ID does not exist, when I open the details URL, then the system shows “Movie not found” and a link back to the movie list.
Given the movie is missing a summary or year, when I open the details page, then the system shows “Information unavailable” for the missing field and still displays the remaining fields.
Given I am viewing movie details, when I return to the movie list, then I can continue the recommendation flow with the signed-in account's saved preferences preserved.

storyAudit.title: [Story] S04 - Explore movies without preferences
storyAudit.statusBasis: Functional evidence exists; final T25 sign-off/review/human details remain pending; not all final DoD gates are asserted

rows.text: Given a newly signed-in account has no preferences and the fallback dataset contains Movie A with popularity score 90, Movie B with score 80, and Movie C with score 80, when I open the recommendations page, then Movie A appears first and Movies B and C are ordered alphabetically by title, with at most 10 movies displayed and marked as not personalised.
Given I am viewing the fallback movie list, when I select Enter preferences, then the system navigates to `/preferences`.

Given the popular movie data is empty, when I open the recommendations page in a newly signed-in account, then the system shows a no-data message and guidance to enter preferences without displaying fake movies.
Given valid preferences have been saved, when I open the recommendations page again, then the system uses the personalized behavior from S02 and follows BR4 if the result is empty.

storyAudit.title: [Story] S12 - Register an account to save personalisation
storyAudit.statusBasis: Functional evidence exists; final T25 sign-off/review/human details remain pending; not all final DoD gates are asserted

rows.text:
Given I enter a valid email address and a password with at least 8 characters,
  when I submit the registration form, then the system creates one account and
  sends me to `/login`.

Given `user@example.com` is already registered, when I register
  `USER@example.com`, then the system does not create another account and shows
  `This email is already registered`.

Given I enter an invalid email address or a password shorter than 8 characters,
  when I submit the form, then the system shows a validation message and does
  not create an account.

Given registration succeeds, when the account is stored, then the password is
  stored only as a secure hash and is never returned by an API response.

storyAudit.title: [Story] S13 - Sign in and sign out of my account
storyAudit.statusBasis: Functional evidence exists; final T25 sign-off/review/human details remain pending; not all final DoD gates are asserted

rows.text:
Given I enter the correct registered email and password, when I sign in, then
  the system creates an authenticated session and opens `/recommendations`.

Given I enter an unknown email or an incorrect password, when I sign in, then
  the system shows `Email or password is incorrect` without stating which field
  was wrong.

Given I am signed out and open `/preferences` or try to save a rating, when
  the protected action is requested, then the system sends me to `/login` and
  does not read or save personalisation data.

Given I am signed in, when I select Sign out, then the system invalidates the
  current authenticated session, opens `/`, and a later request to `/preferences`
  sends me to `/login`.

Given Account A has saved preferences or ratings, when Account B signs in,
  then Account B cannot view, update, reset, or receive recommendations from
  Account A's personalisation data.
